items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Oh Marshall Royal played with me during the war.

ctx.x: Oh Marshall Royal played with me during the war. Marshall and Ernie both played with me during the war. MA: Who are you thinking of then? Grover Mitchell?

Grover Mitchell. I told Grover Mitchell — Grover Mitchell was working in the post office. I said, “Don’t quit your day job.” So one time years ago I saw him in Reno with the Count Basie Band and I’m laughing. Because he played with me. I was the boss. So many things like that you know.
